description: Fetch the metrics series over past ticks (the server keeps the last 5000), with an optional stride to thin the series. This is the tool for locating transitions: polarization tends to change fastest inside a narrow band of ticks. Where is that band for your parameters, and does the separation weight shift it?

flock_id.description: flock session id, as returned by flock_create

from.description: first tick, inclusive; defaults to the earliest tick still buffered (the timeline keeps a bounded ring of recent ticks)

stride.description: return every Nth tick (1 to 100, default 1)

to.description: last tick, inclusive; defaults to the current tick and may not exceed it

name: flock_timeline
